name: Alberto Pecchini
tagline: CAT student · Front-end Developer · Available for web design, front-end development and branding
profile: Fifth-year student on the CAT track (Construction, Environment and Territory) and a self-taught front-end developer & designer. I combine technical training in design and drafting — also gained over three years of work-based learning (PCTO) in the technical office of Caem Group's timber division — with a passion for the web, building modern, fast and carefully crafted interfaces. I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and GSAP animation, with a focus on user experience, typography and minimalist design. I integrate artificial intelligence into my development workflow (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini) and use generative-AI tools such as Nano Banana Pro, DeepSeek and Grok at an advanced level.

experience.title: Work-based learning (PCTO) — Caem Group S.p.A., Castellucchio (MN)
experience.role: Technical office · Timber division · AutoCAD 3D, cadwork
experience.desc: Three years of school-to-work training (PCTO) in the technical office of Caem Group's timber division: 3D modelling of canopies in AutoCAD, observing quotations being drawn up live with the client, and orderly archiving of technical documentation. 232 hours in total across three sessions (80 + 72 + 80), 8 hours a day in a team of seven, working with glulam and X-LAM timber structures.

experience.title: Online sales — Vinted & Subito
experience.desc: Independent management of the entire sales cycle on Vinted and Subito: product appraisal, market pricing, photography with a Canon EOS 4000D and iPhone 16 Pro, listing, negotiation, shipping and feedback handling. First sale December 2019; systematic activity since autumn 2024. Categories: clothing, film collectibles, tech devices (Apple Watch, Nintendo Switch, Flipper Zero).

experience.title: Family farm — Rivalta sul Mincio
experience.desc: Ongoing collaboration in the family farming business: plant care and maintenance (watering, pruning of various kinds), transport of materials on a tractor with trailer, hay harvesting from permanent meadow, coordinating operations with the team and logistical support with transfers. Autonomous handling of equipment and on-field problem-solving.

experience.title: Polling clerk — Section 5, Rivalta sul Mincio
experience.role: Electoral operations · Municipality of Rodigo · Referendum
experience.desc: Official appointment as a polling clerk at electoral section no. 5 of Rivalta sul Mincio (Municipality of Rodigo) for the Referendum of 22–23 March 2026: verifying voters' identity, managing voting operations, counting ballots, drafting the reports and transmitting the results. Paid appointment — fee of €119.60.

experience.title: Rivalta sul Mincio — Website
experience.desc: Design and development of the institutional and tourism website for the village of Rivalta sul Mincio. Minimalist editorial design with careful typography, a warm palette and advanced animations via GSAP ScrollTrigger (pinning, stacking, parallax scrubbing). Gapless bento grids and image-led composition for immersive visual storytelling. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, GSAP, Tailwind CSS.

experience.title: Cascina Fontana — Website
experience.desc: Design and development of the official Cascina Fontana website. Analysis of the client's needs, definition of the information architecture and creation of a responsive, carefully designed interface optimised to present products and services. Direct collaboration with the client on the content. Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

experience.title: Personal portfolio website
experience.desc: Conception and development of the personal portfolio and a hub of web games (Trivia, Mappa, Parole, Angoli, Movimento) plus study material for the final exams (Maturità). A purple «dark premium» design system, section-based architecture, entrance animations, full accessibility (skip links, focus management, prefers-reduced-motion) and continuous deployment on Vercel. Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase.
